title: getdashboarddata_should_return_tasks_and_cognitive_load
description: Verify that the GET /dashboard_data endpoint returns today's tasks sorted by deadline along with cognitive capacity information for the dashboard.

title: postdailynotes_should_save_and_autosave_daily_note
description: Verify that the POST /daily_notes endpoint correctly saves the daily note content and that auto-save updates are reflected properly.

title: postchat_should_process_messages_and_slash_commands
description: Verify that the POST /chat endpoint accepts user messages including slash commands, processes them, and returns streaming response tokens.

title: postupload_should_accept_pdf_files_and_create_jobs
description: Verify that the POST /upload endpoint accepts PDF files with optional processing instructions, initiates processing jobs, and the jobs appear in history.

title: getpdfjobs_should_return_pdf_job_history_with_statuses
description: Verify that the GET /pdf_jobs endpoint returns the list of past PDF processing jobs with correct status badges and updated entries.

title: getusage_should_return_api_cost_meters_for_pdf_and_agent
description: Verify that the GET /usage endpoint returns accurate API cost metrics for both PDF and agent categories.

title: getlogsstream_should_stream_live_system_logs
description: Verify that the GET /logs/stream endpoint streams live system logs continuously and supports expansion to modal view for inspection.

title: gettasks_should_return_all_tasks_with_filters
description: Verify that the GET /tasks endpoint returns all academic and daily tasks and supports filtering by category and status.

title: posttasks_should_create_new_task
description: Verify that the POST /tasks endpoint creates a new academic or daily task with provided details and the task appears in the task list.

title: postworkoutsupload_should_import_workouts_from_files
description: Verify that the POST /workouts/upload endpoint accepts JSON, CSV, or FIT files, imports workouts correctly, and adds them to the workout plan.
